newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SENTRACHEM SAYS DOW OFFER REJECTED.
newsitem.headline: SENTRACHEM SAYS DOW OFFER REJECTED.

text.p: South African chemical company Sentrachem Ltd said on Tuesday that members of its board of directors that were not also directors of major shareholder Sankorp had rejected Dow Chemical's offer for the firm.
"The Board of Sentrachem (other than those directors who are also directors of Sankorp, has considered the terms of the offer from Dow," the company said in a statement.
"The Board of Sentrachem believes that the offer does not adequately represent the value of Sentrachem's businesses."

The U.S. chemical group last week unveiled a 2.074 billion rand bid for Sentrachem. Dow has already sealed an agreement from Sankorp Ltd, which holds 38.74 percent of Sentrachem, to accept and recommend the offer.
Sentrachem on Tuesday recommended shareholders take no action prior to the publication of the offeree circula, which would be posted no later than Monday August 25.
It gave no further details in a brief announcement.
